knowledge_points_labels_check.name: knowledge_points_labels_check
knowledge_points_labels_check.value: coalesce(jsonb_typeof(labels -> 'theme') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(labels -> 'concept') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(labels -> 'atomic') = 'string', false)

notes_polarity_check.name: notes_polarity_check
notes_polarity_check.value: polarity IS NULL OR polarity IN ('neutral_observe', 'positive_exemplar', 'mixed', 'negative_caution')

notes_stance_check.name: notes_stance_check
notes_stance_check.value: stance IS NULL OR stance IN ('transform_ok', 'do_not_imitate_failure_path', 'imitate')

plans_limits_check.name: plans_limits_check
plans_limits_check.value: monthly_tokens >= 0 AND monthly_agent_turns >= 0 AND monthly_web_searches >= 0 AND storage_bytes >= 0
